title: United Makes Status Harder to Get, a Fake Hijack Shuts Down Nuremberg, and Emirates Might Ditch the 787
summary: United overhauls MileagePlus and frequent flyers are not happy, a wrong squawk code sends fighter jets scrambling over Germany, and Emirates is reportedly ready to swap its entire Dreamliner order for more 777Xs. Plus, an update on the Flydubai investigation, Burbank's brand new terminal opens, and Qantas loses a 787 to bedbugs.
